svg.title: Job Application Agent — architecture
svg.desc: Rubric-encoded scoring runs first as a cheap Haiku filter, qualifying jobs escalate to Opus for tailoring, and a menu bar app reads flat files on disk.
svg.text: Rubric drives the score. Cheap model filters, expensive model tailors. UI is a menu bar reading flat files.
1. Rubric scoring with a Haiku/Opus cost split
Every listing scored by the same rubric. Only items clearing the bar pay for Opus.

g.text: Cheap to revisit if rubric changes

svg.text: No database, no web app. The menu bar reads a directory of files on disk and renders them.

g.text: Watches the folder, renders the queue
